title: Settings
description: Canonical Settings contract per DEVOS-SPEC-047. Settings are declarative user preferences in Global/User or Workspace scope. Telemetry defaults to false at every scope; this default is normative.

schemaVersion.description: Settings schema contract version per DEVOS-SPEC-059.

appearance.description: Interface presentation only, such as ui.theme.

editors.description: Bridges to external editors, such as editors.default. Editor names remain illustrative examples of providers.

ai.description: AI routing defaults such as ai.priority and ai.budget feeding DEVOS-SPEC-039 policies.

channel.description: Channel consumed by the Update System per DEVOS-SPEC-048.

enabled.description: MUST default to false at every scope; normative privacy stance of DEVOS-SPEC-047.

log.description: Per-component logging level defaults feeding DEVOS-SPEC-049.

scheduled.description: Opt-in scheduled interval feeding DEVOS-SPEC-046. Absent means no scheduled checks run.

$comment: New categories MUST enter through the canonical categories table of DEVOS-SPEC-047 and this schema before any consumer reads their keys.
